claims.statement: Seed-conditioned neural deconstruction cooperates with classical repair and CPU/GPU sequential reuse; three actual tasks include PCVRP.
Incumbent-aware15-customer autoregressive removal, best-rollout clipped-reward REINFORCE, stale batch guidance sequentially edits changing incumbents under annealing; fixed weights during search.

Task/size-trained models have multi-day offline budgets;11/12 best main displayed results relative heuristic incumbents; baseline training/implementation caveats, PCVRP constant objective and OOD CVRP ranking reversal retained.
Specialist improvement: neural policy removes customers from full incumbents, repair/init classical; separate task/size checkpoints, not shared multi-task training.
